churches.assessment: First United Methodist Church in Midland, Texas was founded in 1885 — the first congregation organized in Midland. On November 5, 1977, 31-year-old future President George W. Bush married 31-year-old Laura Welch at this church's Glass Memorial Chapel; the Glass Chapel was completed in 1976, just a year before the wedding. The Bush wedding gives this church its primary national notability. Current senior pastor is Dr. Tim Walker, with Rev. Kurt Borden as associate. Like Highland Park UMC Dallas, First Methodist Midland stayed within the post-2024 United Methodist Church after the conservative Global Methodist Church disaffiliation wave. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level given the post-2024 UMC departure from biblical authority on sexual ethics. Included for situational awareness about the wedding site of a former president and first lady.

churches.assessment: Highland Park United Methodist Church is a large historic Dallas UMC congregation (founded 1916) at 3300 Mockingbird Lane. George W. Bush was an active member 1989-1995 and volunteered in a ministry serving low-income Hispanic families during those years; the church is currently constructing the President George W. and Laura Bush Family Confirmation Center on the Mockingbird Campus. Rev. Paul Rasmussen served as senior minister 2013-2026 and stepped down due to Parkinson's disease; Rev. Matt Tuggle became senior minister in 2026. Highland Park is institutionally part of the post-2024 United Methodist Church, which removed "incompatibility" language around homosexuality and opened LGBTQ+ ordination and same-sex marriage at the 2024 General Conference. Conservative UMC congregations departed during the 2022-2024 disaffiliation window to form the Global Methodist Church (GMC); Highland Park stayed UMC. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level even if the local congregation is among the more traditional UMC megachurches. Included for situational awareness about a former president's home church.
